Sandbox_CJSFirearmAimingOverhaul_Maximum: Extra seconds used by the normalized far-range curve at a full-weight range gap. The curve also has a one-second entry cost and is scaled by Aiming skill. Default: 5.0.
Sandbox_CJSFirearmAimingOverhaul_CurveEx: Controls how quickly extra time grows as the target moves from effective sight to physical maximum range. Higher values are gentler near sight range and steeper near maximum range. Default: 1.25.
Sandbox_CJSFirearmAimingOverhaul_FullPen: Sight-to-maximum gap that receives the full far-range penalty. Smaller gaps are softened by the square root of their relative size; larger gaps use normalized progress and are not penalized again just for being longer. Default: 10 tiles.
